definitions.sentences: Punctuation sentencizer plus each nonempty line; preserve Art./art. and digit-letter legal references ending in a period as tokens. Semicolons do not split sentences. Identical rules for both versions.
definitions.frequency: Token-weighted surface-form Zipf frequency for alphabetic NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV tokens; exclude PROPN. Higher means more common. Report mean including zero and mean over positive entries only; zero means below resource coverage, not a validated difficulty score. Swiss spelling and domain vocabulary can affect coverage.
definitions.lexical_measures: Alphabetic tokens only. MATTR is mean lemma type-token ratio across overlapping windows of 50 words; unavailable below window size. Density counts NOUN, PROPN, VERB, ADJ, ADV as content words.
definitions.clause_markers: STTS KOUS/KOUI subordinators and PRELS/PRELAT relative markers per 100 alphabetic words. These are proxies, not counts of clauses or embedding depth.
definitions.lix: Alphabetic words per sentence plus percentage of alphabetic words longer than six letters. Tokenization-specific implementation; no grade-level interpretation.
definitions.words: Tokens excluding punctuation and whitespace; numbers included.
definitions.tree_depth: Maximum number of non-punctuation, non-whitespace ancestors per sentence; root depth zero. Document value is the unweighted mean over sentences.
definitions.dependency_distance: Mean absolute word-position distance over non-root dependencies whose endpoints are word tokens; punctuation and whitespace excluded from positions.

limitations: Sample provenance is recorded in the input and methods log. Parser estimates, not validated complexity judgments. Shortening can reflect omissions; length, syntax and tone are different constructs.

uncertainty: These intervals estimate sampling uncertainty in the average difference between machine and official German. We resample motion pairs within each year to preserve the sample’s yearly composition. We use 2,000 resamples with seed 47 reset for each measure for reproducibility and take the middle 95% of the resampled mean differences. Author dependence and multiple comparisons are examined separately in the robustness analysis.
